unexpected_observations: HotplugFailed events (lstat disk.img) fired during hotplug detach in both full and incremental passes, yet SuccessfulDelete of hp-volume pods and backup completion followed - product anomaly recorded, not graded per skill rule

Workload env deviation: actual baseline was 1000 files x 15-20MiB instead of script defaults 8 x 1024MiB (trigger/exit-statuses.json workload_env_actual) - window-widening measure only; spec does not set a pass criterion on workload shape

runs/20261015-cbtf04-r02/summary.json reports full backup status PENDING (stale framework field after Lead repair of run.json); contradicted by live Done=True objects - flagged as framework-record inconsistency, not product failure

Trigger abort at ~06:49:12Z (process group killed post-injection due to harness env leak); full backup and injection had already fired; incremental follow-up executed by RecoveryWorker instead of scripted path - outcome criteria all evidenced, deviation noted
